review.reason: Adds failure recovery and bounded-time protection to report and inbox workflows. P1.F1 and P1.F3 add listeners that reload report metadata after verdict failures, P1.F4 and P1.F16.H5 wrap writes with a timeout, and P1.F10 and P1.F16 preserve locally-written fields during fetches. These are substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvements.
review.posthog_relevance: Today report page and inbox report detail pane reliability and state consistency.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the correctness and behavior of imported helpers and shared utilities not shown; no score assigned for those dependencies.

observations.behavior: Adds a listener in todayReportLogic that, when a verdict action fails, reloads the report list if not using sample data.
observations.posthog_connection: Re-fetches report metadata after a verdict failure to prevent stale state, supporting the Today report page's reliability.

observations.behavior: Adds a listener in todayReportLogic that, when a verdict action fails, reloads the full report if the failed report matches the current report ID.
observations.posthog_connection: Re-fetches report metadata after a verdict failure to prevent stale state, supporting the Today report page's reliability.

observations.behavior: Wraps the inbox report state update with a timeout context, passing options to the underlying API call.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the inbox write operation to be monitored and potentially aborted or retried if it exceeds a configured timeout, supporting inbox reliability.
